version_guard: Verify the published version 2 before reading results.

scoring.metric: Final bank account balance in USD after one simulated year of operation (average across 5 runs)

description: Long-horizon agentic benchmark where models run a simulated vending machine business for a year and are scored on their final bank account balance.
